content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"Yes, the judge resolves the challenger's footed covenant-origin chain by saying the pressed verses do not carry the claim and analyzing them individually rather than weighing chain against chain by footing.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"The pressed verses do not carry covenant-origin into this sentence. John 1:13, \"born of God,\" itself denies \"blood... the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man\" as the source. 1 John 3:9 is about believers' new birth, not a conception. Acts 1:8, \"after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you,\" speaks of power for witness.","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"never verse by verse: (1) the judge may not dismiss a pressed chain by finding each verse alone insufficient; (2) the judge may examine individual verses only as part of weighing the chain's footing.","why":"The judge's Link 2 answer dismisses the challenger's covenant-origin chain by checking individual pressed verses and saying none carries the point, which the rule forbids when the witnesses are the pressing side's own chain read together."}
